scenario_title: Synchronous image verification in the request path
title: Latency and timeouts on api-gateway

detection.alert: api-gateway: p99 latency > 2 s for 5 min

impact: Requests slowed down and a share of them timed out on api-gateway
symptom: [ANOMALY] api-gateway 2026-06-05 14:26-18:56: api-gateway: 238 of 352 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-06-05 14:26 and 2026-06-05 18:56 UTC (peak error ratio 0.93 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 27.811 s vs baseline band up to 0.245 s.

_templates.macro: Deploy {version_to} of cloud-api made base-image verification synchronous in the request path; the shorter ALB health-check timeout then marked slow targets unhealthy.
_templates.micro: {file}:{line} ({symbol}) calls _verify_sync inline instead of submitting it to the executor.
_templates.remediation: Roll back cloud-api {version_to} -> {version_from}; restore the async executor call at {file}:{line}; revert the aws_lb_target_group health_check timeout.

rca.macro: Deploy v3.26.0 of cloud-api made base-image verification synchronous in the request path; the shorter ALB health-check timeout then marked slow targets unhealthy.
rca.micro: cloud-api/nova/image/cache.py:99 (ImageCacheManager.verify_base_images) calls _verify_sync inline instead of submitting it to the executor.
rca.remediation: Roll back cloud-api v3.26.0 -> v3.25.0; restore the async executor call at cloud-api/nova/image/cache.py:99; revert the aws_lb_target_group health_check timeout.

action_items: Add a regression test covering ImageCacheManager.verify_base_images (cloud-api/nova/image/cache.py).
Alert on the error signature `GET <*> <*> <*> target=cloud-api`.
